title: The Energy Cooperative as a Tool for Reducing Energy Poverty and Supporting the Social Regeneration Process

abstracts.content: Energy poverty is a social and economic problem faced by countries around the world. Governments in various countries and regions are creating economic support mechanisms and setting up institutions to help social groups or households that need it most. However, a review of international solutions has failed to find effective proposals that would reduce energy poverty in a systemic, cost-effective (economically profitable) manner. The authors therefore decided to address the possibility of reducing energy poverty in terms of: (I) the use of existing institutions that support prosumer association locally (it was focused on energy cooperatives), and (II) the use of optimization models taking into account actual data of energy producers and consumers. The study takes the form of sensitivity analysis and is based on the institutional and legal framework in Poland. The research works presented demonstrate an innovative mechanism for fighting energy poverty that has not yet been studied or described. It assumes the allocation of a portion of the energy produced from photovoltaic sources belonging to an energy cooperative, in which one of the members is a local government unit, to cover the dedicated needs of electricity demand. The beneficiaries of such a solution would comprise households in the area of the local administration affected by energy poverty. A self-scalable model for developing and supporting an increasing number of entities was achieved, so that we can talk about new solution to mitigate the problem of energy poverty and sustainable social regeneration on a scale larger than just local.

title: Digitization of Cultural Heritage Resources on the Example of a Sacral Object Using a 3D Laser Scanning System

abstracts.content: The article presents the role and process of digitization of cultural heritage resources using the example of a parish church in Borowno, Poland, built in 1845–1846. It is an impressive neoBaroque building, single-nave, with a semicircularly closed presbytery and a two-tower façade. The Trimble X7 3D laser scanning system was used to inventory the object, which enabled precise mapping of geometry in the form of a point cloud. The obtained data was analyzed in terms of scanning quality, accuracy of mapping architectural details, and the possibility of their further use in conservation documentation and 3D modeling. The results of the analysis showed that 3D laser scanning technology is an effective tool for inventorying historic objects, enabling their detailed analysis and archiving in digital form.

title: Revitalisation of the Czepurka Manor House: Balancing Legal, Technical and Functional Challenges

abstracts.content: The paper analyzes the conservation (legal), functional, and technical challenges of the revitalization of the Czepurka Manor House located in Poland. The conservator's requirements were verified against the possibility of revitalizing the manor house, an analysis was made of currently available building materials and the possibility of their use in the restoration of the structure, and the architectural work carried out to date was reviewed. The aim was to adapt the historic manor house to contemporary requirements while considering the design and legal challenges associated with entering the structure on the Register of Historic Monuments.

title: Bioreaktory membranowe w oczyszczaniu ścieków komunalnych

abstracts.content: W związku ze zmianami legislacyjnymi w obszarze wodno-ściekowym, których głównym celem jest ograniczenie presji antropogenicznej na środowisko wodne, w najbliższych latach należy spodziewać się wdrażania nowoczesnych rozwiązań technologicznych w systemach oczyszczania ścieków. Będą one musiały wychodzić naprzeciw współczesnym i przyszłym problemom w sektorze wodno-ściekowym poprzez holistyczne podejście do problemu retencji wody i efektywnego oczyszczania ścieków. Rozwiązania te będą musiały nie tylko umożliwiać efektywniejsze usuwanie substancji biogennych, ale też mikrozanieczyszczeń, jednocześnie maksymalizując możliwość ponownego wykorzystania odzyskanej wody ze ścieków do celów gospodarczych. Do najnowocześniejszych technologii, które są w stanie sprostać tym oczekiwaniom należą membranowe oczyszczalnie ścieków MBR. Z uwagi na możliwość jednoczesnego usuwania zanieczyszczeń nieorganicznych, mikrobiologicznych oraz organicznych, w tym szerokiej grupy mikrozanieczyszczeń, technologia ta może być stosowana do oczyszczania zarówno ścieków komunalnych, jak i przemysłowych. W artykule przedstawiono rozwój technologii MBR na przestrzeni lat, omówiono zasadę działania bioreaktorów i ich konfigurację oraz przedstawiono przykłady zastosowań reaktorów w pełnej

Due to legislative changes in the water and wastewater sector aimed at reducing anthropogenic pressure on the aquatic environment, the coming years are expected to see the implementation of modern technological solutions in wastewater treatment systems. These systems must address current and future challenges through a holistic approach to water retention and efficient wastewater treatment, not only by removing nutrients but also micropollutants, while maximizing the potential for wastewater reuse. One of the most modern technologies are membrane bioreactors MBR. Due to their ability to simultaneously remove inorganic, microbiological, and organic pollutants, including a wide range of micropollutants, this technology can treat both municipal and industrial wastewater. This article presents the development of MBR technology over the years, discusses bioreactors’ operating principles and configurations, and presents examples of full-scale reactor applications and their operational efficiency.

title: Study of Bending of a Locally Heated Orthotropic Plate of a Layered Structure

otherTitles.title: Doslidzennja zginu lokal'no nagritoi ortotropnoi plastyny saruvatoi struktury

abstracts.content: Досліджено згин прямокутної ортотропної пластини шаруватої нерегуляр­ної структури за нестаціонарного локального нагрівання довкіллям. Для цього використано двовимірні рівняння теплопровідності та рівняння зсувної теорії першого порядку неоднорідних ортотропних пластин. Аналітичний розв’язок нестаціонарної задачі теплопровідності та квазістатичної задачі термопруж­ності, за граничних умов шарнірного опертя, побудовано метода­ми інтеграль­ного перетворення Лапласа за часом та скінченного перетворен­ня Фур’є за координатами. Числові результати наведено для тришарових пластин симе­тричної та несиметричної структур.

Based on two-dimensional equations of heat conduction and equations of the shear theory of thermoelasticity, the bending of a rectangular orthotropic plate of a layered irregular structure under unsteady local heating by the environment was studied. Using the methods of integral Fourier and Laplace transforms, a solution of the unsteady problem of heat conduction and the quasi-static problem of thermoelasticity for a plate hinged at the edges were found. Numerical results are given for three-layer plates of symmetric and asymmetric structure.

title: Conditional VAE for Personalized Neurofeedback in Cognitive Training

abstracts.content: Machine learning (ML) offers great potential in healthcare, especially in the analysis of complex physiological signals like electroencephalography (EEG). EEG recordings hold valuable insights into neurological function and can aid in diagnosing various conditions. In this work, we explore the use of a Conditional Variational Autoencoder (CVAE) that injects a binary health label (healthy or orthopedic impairment) into both the encoder input and the latent space coupled with the extracted features, leveraging the conditional input vector to learn representations specific to different health conditions. Our study involved using two public OpenNeuro datasets [1,2]. From the healthy dataset we randomly selected seven subjects to match the seven impaired participants; in both sets we retained the same 11 scalp channels (C3, Cz, C4, FC3, FCz, FC4, CP3, CPz, CP4, F3, F4). Six descriptors-Short time Fourier Transform (STFT), Hurst Exponent (HE), Detrended Fluctuation Analysis (DFA), Correlation Dimension (CD), Kolmogorov-Sinai Entropy (permutation entropy; KS-proxy), and the Largest Lyapunov Exponent (LLE)-are extracted channel-wise and concatenated to form the input feature vector, which distills distinct characteristics from the EEG signals. We rigorously evaluated the performance of our CVAE model in combination with each feature extraction technique. The conditional supply of class labels to both encoder and decoder enabled the CVAE to achieve 93% accuracy on the unseen test split of the dataset with precision of 93%, a recall of 93%, and an F1-score of 0.93 outperforming re-trained CNN baselines. These results highlight the promise of CVAEs and the significance of well-suited feature extraction for robust EEG classification. This work could contribute to the development of automated healthcare diagnostic tools.

title: Analysis of Thick-Walled Oxygen-Free Copper Pipe Production in the Bridge Die Extrusion Process

abstracts.content: This article presents the results of research on the possibility of extruding oxygen-free copper pipes in bridge dies. The possibility of continuous production of a finished product of any length with a uniformly deformed wall was analysed. One of the most important elements of the work was to determine the shape of the tool (die and bridge) that would allow durable connection of the material. Numerical studies conducted using the commercial computer programme FORGE®NxT 2.1, including analysis of the distribution of material temperature and hydrostatic pressure in the welding zone of the bridge die affecting the copper joint during the manufacture of tubular profiles, confirmed the validity of the research issue. The results of the numerical studies were supplemented by laboratory tests, confirming the accuracy of the selected variant of the finished product manufacturing process. The process of bonding under conditions of two-part material compression was used for physical modelling of copper welding. The tests were conducted using the Gleeble 3800 metallurgical process simulator with the PocketJaw module. Based on the analysis of the obtained results, it was found that for tubes with a wall-thickness-to-inner-diameter ratio of 0.5, it is justified to use tools with a longer sizing section and welding chamber, as well as a larger mandrel generating-line angle within the welding chamber.

title: Characteristics of Selected Mechanical Parameters of the Resin-Based Conglomerate

otherTitles.title: Charakterystyka wybranych parametrów mechanicznych konglomeratu na osnowie żywicznej

abstracts.content: W artykule opisano wpływ składu kruszywa na właściwości mechaniczne konglomeratu na osnowie żywicznej. W badaniach wykorzystano trzykomponentowe mieszanki kruszywa o różnych proporcjach frakcji ziarnowych oraz dwuskładnikową żywicę epoksydową. Próbki konglomeratu wykonano zgodnie z ustaloną recepturą, a następnie przeprowadzono testy wytrzymałościowe na ściskanie i zginanie. Analiza wyników wykazała, że największy wpływ na parametry mechaniczne ma jamistość mieszanki – im mniejsza, tym większa wytrzymałość materiału. Konglomeraty o zoptymalizowanej granulacji osiągały wytrzymałość na ściskanie przekraczającą 64 MPa i na zginanie większą od 26 MPa. Potwierdza to, że dobór odpowiedniego uziarnienia kruszywa jest kluczowy przy projektowaniu kompozytów o dużej wytrzymałości. Ze względu na korzystne właściwości użytkowe, analizowane konglomeraty mogą być powszechnie stosowane w inżynierii lądowej jako alternatywa klasycznych mieszanek betonowych.

The aim of the study was to determine the influence of aggregate composition on the mechanical properties of resin- -based conglomerate. The tests used three-component aggregate mixtures with different proportions of grain fractions and a two- -component epoxy resin. Conglomerate samples were prepared according to the established recipe and then subjected to compressive and bending strength tests. Analysis of the results showed that the greatest influence on the mechanical parameters is the void content of the mixture – the lower the void content, the higher the strength of the material. Conglomerates with optimized granulation achieved compressive strength values exceeding 64 MPa and bending resistance above 26 MPa. The obtained results confirm that the selection of the appropriate aggregate grain size is crucial for the design of composites with high strength parameters. Due to their favorable functional properties, the analyzed conglomerates can be widely used in civil engineering as an alternative to classic concrete mixtures.

title: Energy Audit of Road Lighting Installations as a Tool for Improving Efficiency and Visual Safety Conditions

abstracts.content: This study presents an analysis of the condition of street lighting based on a selected typical installation in one of the 1459 rural communes in Poland. The analysis was carried out on the basis of publicly available statistical data, local government reports, and information contained in national and European strategic documents. During the analysis, numerous irregularities and differences in the quality and energy efficiency of the lighting infrastructure were indicated. It was found that outdated sodium luminaires with high energy consumption, low durability, and limited luminous efficacy are used in many cases, which generates significant operating costs and negatively affects the environment. The authors emphasize that a lack of regular and professional lighting audits leads to the suboptimal use of energy resources, an insufficient level of road safety, and failure to adapt lighting to current technical standards and the needs of road users. A lighting audit is a key tool for diagnosing the technical condition, efficiency, and compliance of installations with relevant regulations and recommendations. It also allows for the identification of potential savings and determining the directions of modernization and implementation of energy-saving technologies, such as LED luminaires and intelligent control systems.The presented analysis demonstrates that energy audits are an effective tool for confirming efficiency improvements and enhancing visual safety conditions through better compliance with photometric standards (luminance, lighting uniformity). Direct accident statistics were not within the scope of this study.

title: City Bike Systems as an Element of Building Social Awareness - the Use of Resources in a Sustainable City

abstracts.content: The city bike system is a promising instrument for promoting sustainable urban mobility through reduced energy consumption and environmental awareness support. This study investigates the environmental, economic, political, social, and technological determinants of the efficiency and user acceptance of bike-sharing systems, with a particular focus on new free-floating models (FFBS). We collected the data by implementing a large-scale survey of 60,000 respondents in six cities worldwide, enabling in-depth cross-city comparisons. While confirming that urban bikes are predominantly used for close-distance commutes during peak hours—a phenomenon well discussed in past literature—our findings extend the existing level of technological determinism by pointing to emerging determinants of success within systems. Specifically, the study recognises that technological advancements (e.g., smartphone application design and smart route planning) significantly enhance user satisfaction and running efficiency. Besides, ecologism and health awareness are viewed as all-encompassing psychological drivers that add to previous perceptions characterised by convenience and price considerations. Notably, the report identifies variations in users' behaviour by socio-economic and geographical location, eroding homogeneity in worldwide trends toward adopting bike-sharing. Structural Equation Modelling (SEM) was used to analyse how the most important factors directly and indirectly affect each other, showing that technology, social aspects, and environmental issues have the biggest impact on whether people accept the system. The results yield practical policy suggestions for urban policymakers and planners, emphasising the importance of coordinated public and private strategies, user-focused infrastructure planning, and customised educational programs to facilitate sustainable, equitable urban transport systems.

title: The Importance of Selected Aspects of Organizational Culture and Employer Initiatives from the Perspective of Generation Z

otherTitles.title: Znaczenie wybranych aspektów kultury organizacyjnej oraz działań podejmowanych przez pracodawców w opinii pokolenia Z

abstracts.content: Celem artykułu jest określenie znaczenia wybranych aspektów budujących kulturę organizacyjną przedsiębiorstw oraz inicjatyw podejmowanych przez pracodawców dla pokolenia Z. Artykuł podkreśla znaczenie świadomego budowania kultury organizacyjnej oraz uwzględnienia podejścia do zarządzania różnorodnością pokoleniową, co może stanowić istotne wsparcie dla menedżerów i specjalistów zarządzania zasobami ludzkimi. Przeprowadzone badania koncentrują się na takich aspektach jak: relacje międzyludzkie, wartości firmowe, atmosfera pracy czy działania prospołeczne, które kształtują postrzeganie organizacji przez młodych pracowników.

The aim of this article is to define the importance of selected aspects that shape the organizational culture of companies, as well as the initiatives undertaken by employers in response to the expectations of Generation Z. The article highlights the importance of consciously shaping organizational culture and adopting an integrated approach to generational diversity management, which can provide significant support for managers and human resource professionals. The research conducted focuses on aspects such as: interpersonal relationships, corporate values, workplace atmosphere, and pro-social activities, all of which influence how young employees perceive an organization.

title: Investigation of Force Parameters During Rolling in Relief Rolls

abstracts.content: The paper presents the results of theoretical studies of the force parameters of thick-sheet blanks rolling in relief rolls. Empirical dependences were obtained to determine the average rolling pressure and force. When studying the pressure, the approach of replacing the deformation scheme with a flat analog was used. In the analysis of the force, the finite element method was used to determine the geometric parameters of the deformation zone. Verification of the obtained dependencies was carried out by comparison with the results of computer simulation. Comparative analysis showed high convergence of the calculation and simulation results, as well as the possibility of applying the formulas obtained not only for symmetrical rolling or for speed asymmetry, but also in the case of rolling in relief rolls of different diameters.

title: Generation Z’s Expectations Regarding Behavioural and Technological Aspects of Working Conditions

abstracts.content: The aim of this article is to identify the expectations of generation Z regarding behavioural and technological aspects of working conditions, with a focus on the impact of technology, work flexibility, and innovation. Generation Z, being the youngest group in the labour market, significantly differs from previous generations both in terms of professional values and expectations towards employers. Organizations that adapt their management strategies to these needs can gain a competitive edge by attracting young, dynamic employees. The research presented in this article contributes to the body of studies on generational differences driven by behavioural and technological aspects. Research results indicate the significant importance of a sense of security in terms of job stability, interpersonal relationships, and an adequate level of remuneration for employees. Slightly less significant, but still highly valued, are aspects related to development opportunities, training, and a clear career path with promotions.

title: Revenues and Profitability of Enterprises in Poland in 2022–2024 by Sector

abstracts.content: Purpose: The aim of this article is to analyse the financial condition of enterprises in Poland in 2022–2024 in sectoral terms, broken down into the public and private sectors. Approach/Methodology/Design: The research method used in this area is a review of national and world scientific literature and a quantitative analysis of the financial resources obtained in this way in Poland. Findings: The research has provided new knowledge on the relationship between revenues, profits and losses in the public and private sectors and their regional diversity. Practical Implications: The study allowed for a comparison of the financial results of the public and private sectors in Poland in 2022–2024 on a regional basis. Originality/Value: The article fills the research gap by presenting current data and conclusions that can serve as a reference point for further research on the role of the public and private sectors in shaping economic stability.

title: Koncepcja pracy elektrowni wodorowo-biogazowej z wykorzystaniem OZE

abstracts.content: W rozdziale przedstawiono możliwości pracy koncepcyjnej minielektrowni wodorowo-biogazowej. Minielektrownia opiera się na pracy czterech sektorów, które współpracują ze sobą, wytwarzając energię elektryczną. W skład tych sektorów wchodzi zbiornik fermentacyjny, w którym zachodzi fermentacja substratów, wynikiem czego jest produkt – biogaz. Drugim sektorem jest elektrolizer zasilany energią z OZE. Trzecim sekto- rem jest „inteligentna” rozdzielnia elektryczna wyposażona w magazyny energii, sterująca pracą całej instalacji. Ostatnim, czwartym sektorem jest turbina gazowa spalająca wyprodukowany biogaz i/lub wodór.

The chapter presents the possibilities of the conceptual work of a mini hydrogen--biogas power plant. The mini power plant is based on the work of four sectors that cooperate with each other to produce electricity. These sectors include a fermentation tank, in which the fermentation of substrates takes place, resulting in a product – biogas. The second sector is an electrolyzer powered by energy from renewable sources. The third sector is an “intel-ligent” electrical switchboard equipped with energy storage devices that controls the oper-ation of the entire installation. The last, fourth sector is a gas turbine burning the produced biogas and/or hydrogen.

Process of Relocation of Wooden Buildings Illustrated with the Example of Selected Buildings in Poland

abstracts.content: The article presents the investment process of relocating wooden log-walled buildings using selected buildings from two counties in Poland as an example. The most common method of relocating this type of building is presented, which involves disassembling the building and reassembling it in a new location. The technical challenges facing investors were presented, but so were the ethical challenges of respecting the historical component while adapting to modern housing needs. Also presented is a review of the literature on the subject, a brief historical overview, and selected projects in Poland and around the world.

title: Masywne materiały amorficzne - metody wytwarzania stopu o składzie chemicznym (Fe92,5Si2,5Hf2,5Nb2,5)80B20

abstracts.content: Masywne materiały amorficzne (bulk metallic glasses) są grupą nowoczesnych stopów metalicznych o nieuporządkowanej strukturze atomowej, która zapewnia im unikalne właściwości mechaniczne i fizyczne. W odróżnieniu od klasycznych cienkich taśm amorficznych, ich produkcja wymaga mniejszej szybkości chłodzenia oraz odpowiedniego doboru składu chemicznego zgodnie z kryteriami zwiększającymi zdolność do zeszklenia. W rozdziale przedstawiono dwie kluczowe metody wytwarzania masywnych materiałów amorficznych: metodę wtłaczania ciekłego stopu do chłodzonej formy pod ciśnieniem gazu ochronnego oraz metodę zasysania ciekłego stopu pod wpływem podciśnienia. Omówiono przebieg procesów, wpływ parametrów technologicznych na właściwości otrzymywanych materiałów oraz znaczenie kontroli atmosfery ochronnej. Zaprezentowane techniki umożliwiają otrzymywanie próbek o grubościach oraz wymiarach znacznie większych niż w klasycznych taśmach i jednorodnej strukturze amorficznej, co otwiera szerokie perspektywy dla ich zastosowania w nowoczesnych technologiach.

Bulk metallic glasses (BMG) are a group of modern metallic alloys with a dis-ordered atomic structure, which gives them unique mechanical and physical properties. Unlike conventional amorphous thin ribbons, their production requires lower cooling rates and an appropriate selection of chemical composition, in line with criteria that enhance glass-forming ability. The chapter presents two key methods for producing bulk metallic glasses: the injection of molten alloy into a cooled mold under protective gas pressure, and the suction of molten alloy under vacuum. The course of these processes is discussed, along with the influence of technological parameters on the properties of the obtained materials and the importance of controlling the protective atmosphere. The presented techniques allow for the production of large-sized samples with a homogeneous amorphous structure, opening up broad prospects for their application in modern technologies.

title: Implementacja metody 5 Why w przedsiębiorstwie z branży obuwniczej

abstracts.content: W rozdziale zaprezentowano proces wdrożenia oraz praktycznego zastosowania metody 5 Why w przedsiębiorstwie branży obuwniczej, specjalizującym się w produkcji cholewek damskich. W ramach badań opracowano szczegółową procedurę stosowania metody 5 Why, dostosowaną do warunków funkcjonowania małego zakładu produkcyjnego. Metodę wykorzystano do analizy przypadku rzeczywistego problemu jakościowego, polegającego na pękaniu skórzanego materiału magazynowanego przed procesem produkcyjnym. Zastosowanie metody 5 Why umożliwiło identyfikację źródłowej przyczyny problemu, którą okazał się brak regularnej konserwacji systemu nawilżania powietrza w magazynie. Na podstawie wyników analizy zaproponowano działania prewencyjne, mające na celu poprawę jakości komponentów oraz ograniczenie strat materiałowych. Wykazano, że metoda 5 Why, dzięki swojej prostocie, niskim kosztom wdrożenia oraz wysokiej skuteczności, może być z powodzeniem stosowana w małych przedsiębiorstwach produkcyjnych jako narzędzie wspierające identyfikację i eliminację problemów procesowych i jakościowych.

The aim of the chapter was to present the implementation process and practical application of the 5 Why method in a footwear company specializing in the production of women's uppers. As part of the research, a detailed procedure for using the 5 Why method was developed, adapted to the operating conditions of a small production plant. The 5 Why method was used to analyze the case of a real quality problem, consisting in cracking of leather material stored before the production process. The use of the 5 Why method allowed the identification of the root cause of the problem, which turned out to be the lack of regular maintenance of the air humidification system in the warehouse. Based on the results of the analysis, preventive measures were proposed to improve the quality of components and reduce material losses. It was shown that the 5 Why method, thanks to its simplicity, low implementation costs and high effectiveness, can be successfully used in small manufac-turing companies as a tool supporting the identification and elimination of process and qual-ity problems.

title: Biomateriał ze słomy jęczmiennej jako alternatywne źródło energii

abstracts.content: Braki na rynku paliw tradycyjnych, wzrastające ceny oraz wymogi stawiane państwom członkowskim przez Unię Europejską, mające na celu ograniczenie emisji gazów cieplarnianych, skutkują zwiększonym zainteresowaniem alternatywnymi źródłami energii. Jednym z takich źródeł jest biomasa odpadowa w formie paliwa stałego. Przed przystąpieniem do produkcji paliwa należy zbadać, czy wybrana biomasa spełnia podstawowe wymagania zawarte w normach europejskich. Badania przedstawione w niniejszym rozdziale skupiają się na wykazaniu potencjału energetycznego materiału w postaci słomy jęczmiennej. W tym celu wybraną biomasę przekształcono w paliwo stałe w procesie pelletyzacji. Po przetworzeniu materiału przeprowadzono szereg badań mających sprawdzić wybrane właściwości fizykochemiczne powstałego paliwa. Wyniki badań porównano z obecnym na rynku pelletem komercyjnym oraz pelletem z innego gatunku biomasy odpadowej. Otrzymane wyniki dla wartości opałowej 15,78 MJ/kg, zawartości wilgoci 7,44% oraz zawartości popiołu 7,41% nie wskazują na istotne odchylenia od normy oraz udowadniają, że pellet ze słomy jęczmiennej może być paliwem przyjaznym dla środowiska i skutecznym w produkcji ciepła.

Shortages on the traditional fuel market, rising prices and requirements imposed by the European Union on Member States aimed at reducing greenhouse gas emissions result in increased interest in alternative energy sources. One such source is waste biomass. Before starting fuel production, it is necessary to check whether the selected biomass meets the basic requirements contained in European standards. The research presented in this work focuses on demonstrating the energy potential of the material in the form of barley straw. For this purpose, the selected biomass was transformed into solid fuel in the pelleti-zation process. After processing the material, a number of tests were carried out to check selected physicochemical properties of the resulting fuel. The test results were compared with commercial pellets currently on the market and pellets from other types of waste bio-mass. The results obtained for the calorific value (15.78 MJ/kg); moisture content (7.44%) and ash content (7.41%) do not indicate significant deviations from the norm, and prove that barley straw pellets can be an environmentally friendly fuel that is also effective in heat production.

title: Rola biogazowni w strategii zrównoważonego rozwoju i zarządzaniu odpadami

abstracts.content: Rozwój gospodarczy wymaga podejmowania działań świadomych i zrównoważonych, a jednym z globalnych wyzwań staje się obecnie odpowiedzialne zarządzanie odpadami pochodzącymi z różnych sektorów działalności człowieka. W poszukiwaniu wydajnych i opłacalnych ekonomicznie rozwiązań opracowywane są plany oraz strategie, mające na celu zmniejszenie negatywnego wpływu gospodarki na środowisko. W rozdziale omówiono problematykę odpadów oraz aktualne technologie i przyszłe kierunki ich przetwarzania, w tym fermentację metanową. Przedstawiono także założenia Agendy 2030, uwzględniając rolę biogazowni w osiąganiu jej celów. W rozdziale zostały również poruszone kwestie recyklingu oraz rozwoju inteligentnych systemów zarządzania odpadami. Biogazownie jako instalacje przetwarzające odpady i produkujące poferment oraz biogaz, będący źródłem energii cieplnej i elektrycznej, stanowią kluczowy element gospodarki o obiegu zamkniętym (GOZ). Rozdział zawiera podział biogazowni ze względu na rodzaj przetwarzanych odpadów oraz podstawy biochemiczne procesu. Ponadto przedstawiono korzyści oraz wyzwania związane z budową i eksploatacją elektrociepłowni na biogaz.

Economic development requires taking conscious and sustainable actions, and one of the current global challenges is the responsible management of waste from various sectors of human activity. In the search for efficient and economically viable solutions, plans and strategies are being developed to reduce the negative impact of economic activi-ties on the environment. This chapter discusses the issue of waste, current technologies, and future directions for processing, including methane fermentation. The assumptions of the 2030 Agenda are also presented, with particular emphasis on the role of biogas plants in achieving its goals. The chapter also addresses the topics of recycling and the development of intelligent waste management systems. Biogas plants, as facilities that process waste and produce both digestate and biogas – as a source of heat and electricity – are a key element of the circular economy (CE). It includes a classification of biogas plants based on the type of waste processed and an overview of biochemical foundations of the process. Addition-ally, the benefits and challenges related to the construction and operation of biogas plants are presented.

book.title: Współczesne wyzwania w inżynierii materiałowej i zarządzaniu produkcją

title: Analiza możliwości wykorzystania wodoru RFNBO w warunkach polskich

abstracts.content: W niniejszym rozdziale wskazano możliwości produkcji wodoru odnawialnego – zielonego – w elektrolizerach. Przedstawiono rodzaje elektrolizerów spotykanych na rynku oraz wskazano klasyfikację wodoru w zależności od zastosowanego surowca z wykorzystaniem kolorów. Wodór jako nośnik energii ze względu na swoje specyficzne właściwości wymaga specjalnego podejścia podczas projektowania sieci przesyłowych i zbiorników umożliwiających jego magazynowanie. W kontekście konieczności modernizacji gazociągów obecnie wykorzystywanych, dyfuzyjność wodoru oraz degradacja materiałów wywołana dyfuzją wodoru będą miały istotne znaczenie w zakresie zachowania bezpieczeństwa użytkowników tegoż nośnika energii. Opublikowana w 2023 roku Dyrektywa RED III wyznacza nowe cele i procedury przyspieszone oraz wskazuje na konieczność wdrożenia produkcji i wykorzystania paliw odnawialnych pochodzenia niebiologicznego, co stanowi nowe wyzwania dla polskiej gospodarki energetycznej i branży transportowej. Celem badań jest dokonanie oceny obecnie obserwowanego rozwoju branży wodorowej w Polsce i wskazanie, czy Polska dysponuje potencjałem na tyle, aby mogła należeć do liderów wdrażających innowacyjne technologie wodorowe. W rozdziale wskazano najistotniejsze działania, jakie należy podjąć, aby oprzeć założenia transformacji energetycznej na produkcji wodoru z odnawialnych źródeł energii.

The chapter presents the possibilities of producing renewable hydrogen – green hydrogen – in electrolysers. The types of electrolysers found on the market are presented and the classification of hydrogen depending on the raw material used using colours are indicated. Due to its specific properties, hydrogen as an energy carrier requires a special approach when designing transmission networks and tanks enabling its storage. In the con-text of the need to modernise currently used gas pipelines, hydrogen diffusivity and degra-dation of materials caused by hydrogen diffusion will be of significant importance in main-taining the safety of users of this energy carrier. The RED III Directive published in 2023 sets new goals and accelerated procedures, and indicates the need to implement the produc-tion and use of renewable fuels of non-biological origin, which poses new challenges for the Polish energy economy and the transport industry. The aim of the study is to assess the currently observed development of the hydrogen industry in Poland and to indicate whether Poland has the potential to be one of the leaders in implementing innovative hydrogen tech-nologies. The survey indicates the most important actions that need to be taken to base the assumptions of the energy transformation on the production of hydrogen from renewable energy sources.

title: Piroliza w recyklingu chemicznym tworzyw sztucznych – aspekty środowiskowe, ekonomiczne i technologiczne

abstracts.content: Piroliza, jako proces termochemicznego recyklingu odpadów z tworzyw sztucznych, stanowi jedną z kluczowych technologii we współczesnym systemie zarządzania odpadami. W odróżnieniu od recyklingu mechanicznego umożliwia ona odzysk surowców w postaci olejów, gazów oraz węgla stałego (karbonizatu), które mogą być ponownie wykorzystane jako paliwa lub surowce do produkcji nowych materiałów. Proces ten przyczynia się jednocześnie do ograniczenia emisji CO2 oraz zmniejszenia obciążenia składowisk odpadami. W porównaniu z konwencjonalnymi metodami przetwarzania odpadów z tworzyw sztucznych piroliza pozwala w sposób bardziej wszechstronny i przyjazny dla środowiska zagospodarować heterogeniczne strumienie odpadów polimerowych. W rozdziale omówiono najważniejsze korzyści środowiskowe i gospodarcze wynikające z wdrażania technologii pirolizy w systemy recyklingu, a także wyzwania związane z jej szerokim zastosowaniem na skalę przemysłową.

Pyrolysis, as a process of thermochemical recycling of plastic waste, is one of the key technologies in the modern system of managing waste. Unlike mechanical recy-cling, it allows recovery of raw materials in the form of oils, gases and solid carbon (car-bonisate), which can be reused as fuels or raw materials for the production of new materials. At the same time, the process contributes to reducing CO2 emissions and reducing the bur-den on landfills. Compared to conventional plastic waste processing methods, pyrolysis allows heterogeneous polymer waste streams to be managed in a more versatile and envi-ronmentally friendly manner. This chapter discusses the key environmental and economic benefits of implementing pyrolysis technology in recycling systems, as well as the chal-lenges associated with its widespread use on an industrial scale.

title: Implementacja filozofii Kaizen w doskonaleniu jakości procesów rejestracji i poboru próbek surowców polimerowych w technologii produkcji kauczuku

abstracts.content: W rozdziale zaprezentowano znaczenie filozofii Kaizen w doskonaleniu procesów rejestracji i poboru próbek surowców polimerowych. W pracy skupiono się na wdrożeniu ciągłego doskonalenia w wybranym przedsiębiorstwie, analizując wpływ małych, systematycznych ulepszeń na jakość i efektywność kontroli surowców. Badania przeprowadzono na podstawie studium przypadku, uwzględniając wdrożone zmiany w procedurach rejestracji i poboru próbek. Zastosowano podejście PDCA (Plan-Do-Check-Act), analizując skuteczność nowych standardów oraz ich wpływ na redukcję barier utrudniających wykonywanie zadań badawczych oraz minimalizację czasu poświęcanego na czynności administracyjne związane z próbkami.

The chapter presents the importance of Kaizen philosophy in improving the pro-cesses of registration and sampling of polymer raw materials. The survey focuses on the implementation of continuous improvement in a selected company, analyzing the impact of small, systematic improvements on the quality and efficiency of raw material control. The research was conducted on the basis of a case study, taking into account the imple-mented changes in registration and sampling procedures. The PDCA (Plan-Do-Check-Act) approach was used, analyzing the effectiveness of new standards and their impact on reduc-ing barriers to performing research tasks and minimizing the time spent on administrative activities related to samples.

title: Selected Technical Aspects of Managing Efficient Heat Supply in a District Heating System

abstracts.content: District heating networks are key components of efficient heat supply systems for municipal and industrial consumers. The purpose of the research presented in this article was to analyze the thermo-hydraulic parameters of the operation of a transmission main in a district heating network to improve the heat transfer efficiency. Based on a literature review of existing studies, the basic issues of the heat supply process were discussed, and selected methods and tools for simulating district heating networks were characterized. A detailed mathematical description of the phenomena occurring during heat transport in a district heating network pipeline was also presented. Then, analytical calculations and simulations were carried out for the selected district heating system using Termis software. Operational parameters collected in the actual district heating system were used as output data for analytical modeling. Pressure drops, power losses, and heat transfer efficiencies in the main buses at different outdoor temperatures during the heating season were determined. Selected results of the study were included, and possibilities for improving the efficiency of heat transfer in the studied district heating network were indicated.

journal.title: Scientific Journals of the Maritime University of Szczecin-Zeszyty Naukowe Akademii Morskiej w Szczecinie

title: Selected Pillars of Corporate Social Responsibility in the Context of Sustainable Development – ​​Environment and Social Involvement

abstracts.content: The concept of corporate social responsibility (CSR) is changing, evolving and is still the subject of interest of many authors. Currently, CSR is not only an idea, but also an approach to management, an element of strategy and management of an organization. In integrating social responsibility with the activities of an organization, it is extremely important to understand the philosophy of social responsibility, its principles and benefits associated with it. When creating development strategies, enterprises voluntarily take into account social interests, the good of the natural environment, as well as relations with various stakeholder groups in their activities. The aim of the conducted research was to learn about the opinions of entrepreneurs on the concept of social responsibility, its main pillars, applied principles and examples of activities in this area, and to examine the relationships between individual activities in the area of ​​two pillars: environment and social involvement. The study was conducted in 2024 among SME sector enterprises. The selection of the sample for the research was purposeful. The research results show that the most important and most frequently indicated aspects of corporate social responsibility according to SME entrepreneurs within the pillar: environment were the promotion of ecological solutions, production of ecological products, use of ecological technologies, production processes and segregation of waste, recycling, disposal, reduction of harmful dust, waste. On the other hand, within the pillar of social involvement, the most important aspects of CSR were activities for the local community and society, including charitable activities and educational activities and raising public awareness. In the pillar of environment, statistically significant relationships between the areas studied are inversely proportional. The area of ​​education in the field of environmental protection shows a relationship with the area of ​​compliance with environmental protection standards and regulations, which in turn is additionally dependent on the area of ​​promoting ecological solutions. The area of ​​promoting ecological solutions also shows a relationship with the area of ​​saving water, energy, paper, etc. The area of ​​segregation of waste, recycling shows a relationship with the area of ​​saving water, energy, paper, etc. In the pillar of social involvement, statistically significant relationships between the areas occurring in it are also inversely proportional. The area of ​​action for the local community shows a relationship with the area of ​​cooperation with local institutions and this area is dependent on the area of ​​local development initiatives. The area of ​​local development initiatives shows a relationship with the area of ​​educational activities. Additionally, from the environment pillar, the area of ​​environmental protection education was positively correlated with the area from the social involvement pillar of employee volunteering for the local community. This means that there is a statistically significant relationship between these two areas. Also, the area of ​​promoting ecological solutions is positively correlated with the area of ​​local development initiatives from the social involvement pillar, which means that when choosing this area, respondents also chose the mentioned area from the social involvement pillar. The area of ​​employee volunteering for the local community did not show a statistically significant relationship with the other areas examined in this pillar.

title: Model geotermalno-krasowy zasilania wód słodkich: propozycja alternatywna wobec klasycznego cyklu hydrologicznego

otherTitles.title: Geothermal-Karst Model of Freshwater Recharge: an Alternative to the Classical Hydrological Cycle

abstracts.content: Niniejsza praca przedstawia alternatywny, koncepcyjny model geotermalno-krasowego zasilania wód słodkich, stanowiący uzupełnienie wobec klasycznego cyklu hydrologicznego, opartego na parowaniu atmosferycznym, opadach i infiltracji powierzchniowej. Proponowany model integruje procesy geotermalnego podgrzewania solanki, transportu pary wodnej w szczelinach kliważowych – zarówno w warunkach kapilarnych, jak i ciśnieniowych – oraz jej kondensacji w chłodniejszych strefach górotworu. Ujęto również endotermiczne reakcje chemiczne, takie jak rozpuszczanie CO2 w kapilarach wodnych, w tym mikrokapilarach o wysokim ciśnieniu, prowadzące do tworzenia kwasu węglowego (H2CO2), oraz rozpuszczanie węglanu wapnia (CaCO2) przez wodę zawierającą CO2. Reakcje te przebiegają z pochłanianiem ciepła i lokalnym obniżeniem temperatury, co przyczynia się do stabilizacji termicznej wypływu. W przeciwieństwie do klasycznych ujęć hydrogeologicznych, model zakłada istnienie głębokiego zbiornika zasilającego, w którym energia magmy inicjuje cykl parowania i separacji soli. Skroplona woda przemieszcza się następnie przez struktury krasowe, niezależnie od sezonowych fluktuacji klimatycznych. Obecność reliktowych organizmów zimnolubnych (np. Gammarus pulex, Dugesia gonocephala) w źródłach o stałej temperaturze stanowi biologiczne potwierdzenie izolacji hydrotermalnej. Model znajduje częściowe potwierdzenie w dostępnej literaturze hydrogeologicznej, lecz proponuje nowy mechanizm transportu wody – oparty na ciśnieniu pary wodnej oraz efektach rozprężeniowych – który może lokalnie działać wbrew gradientowi grawitacyjnemu. W tym ujęciu rozpuszczanie nie jest warunkiem koniecznym: wystarczająca jest wymiana energii pomiędzy fazą gazową a cieczą, prowadząca do schłodzenia otaczającego środowiska i stabilizacji parametrów fizycznych wody. Model ten może stanowić podstawę do rewizji klasyfikacji źródeł krasowych, reinterpretacji genezy pokładów soli oraz prognozowania zasobów wodnych w strefach głębokich.

This study presents an alternative conceptual model of geothermal–karst freshwater recharge, serving as a complement to the classical hydrological cycle based on atmospheric evaporation, precipitation, and surface infiltration. The proposed model integrates processes of geothermal brine heating, vapor transport through cleavage fractures – under both capillary and pressure- driven conditions – and condensation in cooler zones of the rock mass. It also includes endothermic chemical reactions, such as the dissolution of CO2 in water capillaries, including high-pressure microcapillaries, leading to the formation of carbonic acid (H2CO2), as well as the dissolution of calcium carbonate (CaCO2) by CO2- enriched water. These reactions proceed with heat absorption and localized temperature reduction, contributing to the thermal stabilization of the outflow. In contrast to classical hydrogeological approaches, the model assumes the existence of a deep recharge reservoir, where magmatic energy initiates a cycle of evaporation and salt separation. The condensed water subsequently migrates through karst structures, independently of seasonal climatic fluctuations. The presence of relict cold-adapted organisms (e.g., Gammarus pulex, Dugesia gonocephala) in springs with stable temperatures provides biological evidence of hydrothermal isolation. The model finds partial support in existing hydrogeological literature, yet proposes a novel mechanism of water transport – driven by vapor pressure and expansion effects – which may locally operate against the gravitational gradient. In this framework, dissolution is not a necessary condition: energy exchange between the gaseous and liquid phases is sufficient to induce cooling of the surrounding environment and stabilization of the water’s physical parameters. This model may serve as a basis for revising the classification of karst springs, reinterpreting the genesis of salt deposits, and forecasting water resources in deep subsurface zones.

title: Handwritten Digit Recognition with Flood Simulation and Topological Feature Extraction

abstracts.content: This paper introduces a novel approach to handwritten digit recognition based on directional flood simulation and topological feature extraction. While traditional pixel-based methods often struggle with noise, partial occlusion, and limited data, our method leverages the structural integrity of digits by simulating water flow from image boundaries using a modified breadth-first search (BFS) algorithm. The resulting flooded regions capture stroke directionality, spatial segmentation, and closed-area characteristics, forming a compact and interpretable feature vector. Additional parameters such as inner cavities, perimeter estimation, and normalized stroke density enhance classification robustness. For efficient prediction, we employ the Annoy approximate nearest neighbors algorithm using ensemble-based tree partitioning. The proposed method achieves high accuracy on the MNIST (95.9%) and USPS (93.0%) datasets, demonstrating resilience to rotation, noise, and limited training data. This topology-driven strategy enables accurate digit classification with reduced dimensionality and improved generalization.

title: Determinants of Activity and the Impact of Existing Threats on the State of the Polish Heating Industry

abstracts.content: Purpose: The purpose of this article is to identify existing threats to the operations of local district heating companies, as well as to indicate their impact on the condition of the Polish heating industry. Design/methodology/approach: The stated aim was achieved through the use of a method of desk data analysis (desk research). The study used information from the activity reports of 158 local district heating companies. Findings: The research conducted made it possible to systematize the current threats and their impact on the operation of the heating in Poland in the era of energy transition. They also showed the ability of managers of local district heating companies to recognize existing risks. Research limitations/implications: The obtained research results concern the identification of threats by local heating companies in the period before the occurrence of emergency events (pandemic and war in Ukraine). It is advisable to repeat the research after the stabilization of prices on fuel markets. Originality/value: In a cognitive sense, the results of the study identify the hierarchy of threats to the operations of local district heating companies. They also prove the correctness of management's identification of risks by indicating their impact on the condition of the Polish heating sector.

title: Erozja stali nierdzewnej w procesie magnetronowego rozpylania

abstracts.content: Rozdział dotyczy problematyki magnetronowego rozpylania stali nierdzewnej. Bazując na targecie (materiale rozpylanym) wykonanym ze stali nierdzewnej X2CrNi18-8 (AISI304L), dokonano charakterystyki ubytku masy i grubości targetu w funkcji czasu w zakresie 2-10 h procesu rozpylania w warunkach mocy magnetronu wynoszącej 0,52 kW. Oszacowano ubytek masy na poziomie 0,2 g/h i grubości 96 μm/h.

In the chapter, the problem of magnetron sputtering of stainless steel is analysed. Based on the target (sputtered material) made of X2CrNi18-8 (AISI304L) stainless steel, the mass loss and thickness of the target were characterized as a function of time in the range of 2-10 h of the sputtering process under the conditions of the magnetron power of 0.52 kW. The mass loss was estimated at 0.2 g/h and the thickness at 96 μm/h.

title: Wpływ dodatku montmorylonitu na właściwości i krystaliczność kompozytów na osnowie polietylenu

abstracts.content: W rozdziale przedstawiono wyniki badań właściwości mechanicznych oraz wyznaczono stopień krystaliczności kompozytów na osnowie polietylenu z napełniaczem w postaci montmorylonitu. Próba rozciągania oraz pomiar twardości umożliwił analizę wpływu napełniacza na właściwości mechaniczne. Zmiana właściwości polimeru następuje już po dodaniu kilku procent wagowych montmorylonitu. Badania z wykorzystaniem dyfraktometru rentgenowskiego pozwoliły na analizę struktury krystalicznej badanych kompozytów. Dodatek montmorylonitu MMT do polietylenu wysokiej gęstości HDPE w niedużym stopniu zmienia krystalografię polimerowej osnowy. Na krzywych dyfrakcyjnych kompozytu pojawiają się mało widoczne piki pochodzące od faz krystalicznych nanonapełniacza. Montmorylonit powoduje obniżenie intensywności refleksów pochodzących od polimerowej osnowy.

This chapter presents the results of mechanical properties and determines the degree of crystallinity of polyethylene matrix composites with montmorillonite filler. Tensile testing and hardness measurement made it possible to analyse the effect of filler on mechanical properties. A change in the properties of the polymer occurs after the addition of a few percent by weight of montmorillonite. Tests using an X-ray diffractometer made it possible to analyse the crystal structure of the composites studied. The addition of MMT montmorillonite to HDPE high-density polyethylene changes the crystallography of the polymer matrix to a small extent. Little visible peaks appear on the diffraction curves of the composite, originating from the crystalline phases of the nanofiller. Montmorillonite causes a reduction in the intensity of reflections coming from the polymer matrix.

title: Optymalizacja procesu produkcyjnego na przykładzie produkcji urządzeń sanitarnych

abstracts.content: Dzięki optymalizacji systemu produkcyjnego można w sposób znaczący zwiększyć efektywność przedsiębiorstwa, czyli uzyskiwać lepsze efekty przy udziale niż-szych kosztów. W niniejszym rozdziale przeprowadzono analizę mającą na celu ocenę wskaźników efektywności oraz możliwości ich poprawy poprzez optymalizację wybranych elementów systemu produkcyjnego. Analizie oraz porównaniu poddano dwa piece tunelowe: PT VC i PT FFC, wykorzystywane w procesie suszenia wyrobów ceramiki sanitarnej – brodzików. Dokonano charakterystyki wybranego obiektu badawczego i procesu produkcyjnego, a także przeprowadzono analizę efektywności pieców tunelowych oraz zaproponowano zmiany wpływające na poprawę efektywności ich pracy. W rozdziale przedstawiono kluczowe działania dotyczące optymalizacji jako elementu zarządzania procesem produkcyjnym. Zawarto w nim również charakterystykę obiektu badawczego, na podstawie której zostały przeprowadzone badania, a także analizę efektywności wytwarzanych wyrobów. Wyniki badań obrazują działanie firmy zarówno na arenie międzynarodowej, jak i na rynku krajowym, z uwzględnieniem wytwarzanych produktów i oferty przedsiębiorstwa. Rozdział zawiera opis oraz porównanie technologii stosowanych w jednym z omawianych zakładów produkcyjnych, w tym parametrów osiąganych przy użyciu dwóch wybranych technologii, które posłużyły do dalszych badań. Zestawiono wspomniane wcześniej wskaźniki i analizę efektywności pieców tunelowych służących do wypału wyrobów ceramicznych oraz dokonano ich porównania na podstawie obliczeń i analiz. Omówiono też techno-logie wykorzystywane w przedsiębiorstwie i różnice między nimi, a także działalność pieców służących do wypału wytwarzanych wyrobów dwiema technologiami.

Efficiency is linked to the concept of optimisation, as it can be effectively increased. Their main objective is to achieve the best possible results at low cost, which is taken into account in this chapter, which aims to evaluate efficiency indicators and the pos-sibility of optimising selected elements of this system towards improved efficiency. Two tunnel kilns PT VC and PT FFC used in the drying process of sanitary ceramic products – shower trays – were analysed and compared. Thus, a characterisation of the selected re-search facility, the production process, and an analysis of the efficiency of the tunnel kilns was carried out, together with a proposal of measures to improve their efficiency. The chap-ter presents key measures for optimisation as part of the management of the production process. It deals with the characteristics of the research facility on which the research and related analyses of the efficiency of the manufactured products were based. The information included therein shows the company’s performance in the national arena, but also in the domestic market with regard to the products manufactured and the company’s offer. The chapter contains a comparison of the technologies used in one of the production facilities in question. They are described and compared, including the parameters of two selected ones, which will serve for further research. A comparison of the aforementioned indicators and an analysis of the efficiency of tunnel kilns used for firing ceramic products was con-ducted. The technologies used in the company and the product manufacturing process are discussed, and the operation of the furnaces used to fire the manufactured products with the two technologies is presented.

title: Charakterystyka parametrów energetyczno-siłowych mobilnego robota diagnostycznego

abstracts.content: W rozdziale przedstawiono wyniki badań parametrów energetyczno-siłowych układu jezdnego mobilnego robota diagnostycznego stalowych wyrobów długich, opracowywanego przez Studenckie Koło Naukowe Mechatroniki „Mecatroo” Politechniki Częstochowskiej. Przeprowadzone pomiary pozwoliły na wyznaczenie rzeczywistego poboru mocy przez układ napędowy robota w uzależnieniu od zmieniających się warunków i za-dawanych parametrów jazdy.

In the chapter, the results of research on the energy and power parameters of the drive system of a mobile robot for diagnostics of long steel products, developed by the Mecatroo Student Scientific Associations for Mechatronics at CUT are presented. The measurements allowed for the determination of the actual power consumption of the robot’s drive system, depending on changing conditions and set driving parameters.

title: Analiza właściwości elementów metalowych otrzymanych w technologii druku 3D

abstracts.content: W rozdziale przedstawiono ocenę właściwości metalowego elementu motocykla Harley JD wykonanego technologią druku 3D. Do jego wytworzenia użyto filamentu ze stali austenitycznej 316L, a model opracowano na podstawie oryginalnych wymiarów części. Po wydrukowaniu element poddano analizie i ocenie. Wyniki potwierdziły możliwość skutecznego odtworzenia elementu konstrukcyjnego motocykla przy użyciu druku 3D.

The survey presented in the chapter includes an assessment of the properties of a metal component of the Harley JD motorcycle manufactured using 3D printing technol-ogy. The component was produced using 316L austenitic stainless steel filament, and the model was developed based on the original part’s dimensions. After printing, the compo-nent was analyzed and evaluated. The results confirmed the feasibility of an effective reproduction of motorcycle’s structural component using 3D printing.

title: Stopy niklowo-tytanowe - struktura, zastosowanie

abstracts.content: Stopy na bazie niklu i tytanu to stosunkowo nowa grupa materiałów. Cechą charakterystyczną tych stopów są właściwości superelastyczne – są to materiały z pamięcią kształtu. Efekt ten jest związany z odwracalną termoelastyczną przemianą martenzytyczną. Największe zastosowanie znalazły stopy, w których procentowy udział atomów niklu i tytanu jest w przybliżeniu równy. Struktury krystaliczne, w jakich związek ten występuje, zależą od temperatury i są mocno złożone. Stopy te znalazły szerokie zastosowanie w wielu branżach, począwszy od lotnictwa, przez branżę samochodową, po medycynę.

Nickel- and titanium-based alloys represent a relatively new group of materials. A characteristic feature of these alloys is their superelastic properties – they are shape memory materials. This effect is related to a reversible thermoelastic martensitic transfor-mation. The most commonly used alloys are those in which the atomic percentage of nickel and titanium is approximately equal. The crystal structures in which this compound exists depend on temperature and are highly complex. These alloys have found widespread appli-cation across various industries, ranging from aerospace and automotive to medicine.

title: Synteza biomateriałów porowatych na bazie bioszkła oraz węglanu wapnia

abstracts.content: Regeneracja ubytków kostnych, spowodowanych urazami, chorobami nowotworowymi, cywilizacyjnymi lub genetycznymi, to współczesne i bardzo istotne wyzwanie w inżynierii tkanki kostnej. Szkła bioaktywne są zdolne do tworzenia trwałego połączenia z tkanką kostną i z tego powodu są wykorzystywane do syntezy bioaktywnych rusztowań kostnych. Rusztowania tego rodzaju, poza tworzeniem bezpiecznego połączenia z tkanką kostną uzyskanego poprzez formowanie hydroksyapatytu węglanowego na ich powierzchni, umożliwiają również proliferację komórek i dostarczanie substancji odżywczych oraz usuwanie metabolitów. W technologii szkła powszechnie znanym środkiem spieniającym stosowanym w procesie spiekania szkła jest węglan wapnia, ponieważ ulega on rozkładowi w wysokiej temperaturze z wydzieleniem dwutlenku węgla. Wydzielone cząsteczki gazu penetrują masę szklaną w obrębie próbki, pozostawiając po spiekaniu strukturę komórkową. W rozdziale przedstawiono próbę uzyskania materiałów porowatych z wykorzystaniem Bioszkła 45S5 i węglanu wapnia (5%). Do uformowania próbek jako lepiszcze wykorzystano szkło wodne oraz wodę. Otrzymane biomateriały zbadano pod kątem właściwości strukturalnych, mikrostrukturalnych oraz fizycznych. Uzyskane wyniki pozwoliły ocenić zarówno jakościowo, jak i ilościowo efekty przeprowadzonego procesu spiekania ze spienianiem.

Regeneration of bone defects caused by injuries, cancer, civilization or genetic diseases is a contemporary and very important challenge in bone tissue engineering. Bio-active glasses are capable of creating a permanent connection with bone tissue, which is why they are used to synthesize bioactive bone scaffolds. Scaffolds of this type, apart from creating a safe connection with bone tissue obtained by forming carbonate hydroxyapatite on their surface, also enable cell proliferation and supply of nutrients and removal of me-tabolites. In glass technology, calcium carbonate is a commonly known foaming agent used in the glass sintering process, because it decomposes at high temperature with the release of carbon dioxide. The released gas molecules penetrate the glass mass within the sample, leaving a cellular structure after sintering. In this work, an attempt was made to obtain po-rous materials using Bioglass 45S5 and calcium carbonate (5%). Water glass and water were used to form the samples. The obtained biomaterials were tested and characterized in terms of structural, microstructural and physical properties, and the obtained results allowed for both qualitative and quantitative assessment of the effects of the foaming process.

title: Investigation of the Effect of Thermal Post-Treatment on Density and Hardness of a Green Prt Printed with FFF Technology

abstracts.content: Additive manufacturing technologies can offer a cost-effective alternative to the production of metal parts of complex geometric shape compared to traditional production or expensive methods of melting powder coatings. In this work, the starting materials were developed by adding 75 % by volume to 316 L stainless steel powder and 25 % by volume from LDPE materials as a binder. Methods of burning and sintering were carried out in a hydrogen atmosphere at a temperature of 1387°C. The resulting metal sample was described mechanically and microstructurally. After sintering the metal samples have a powder size of ~ 7 μm, a level of 250 MPa and a nanoindentation hardness of 4.87 GPa, which are the characteristic features of burnt steel.

title: Ocena właściwości mieszanek butylowych modyfikowanych odpadem z gumy do żucia

abstracts.content: Guma do żucia to produkt o rosnącym znaczeniu ekonomicznym i różnorodnym zastosowaniu, jednak jego odpady są trudne do biodegradacji, co stanowi poważny problem środowiskowy. W rozdziale przedstawiono badania, których celem była ocena parametrów mieszanek butylowych wykorzystywanych w materiałach uszczelniających modyfikowanych odpadami z gumy do żucia. Ocenie poddano dwa typy odpadów poprodukcyjnych: zawierające wyłącznie bazę gumową oraz bazę z dodatkami spożywczymi. Przeprowadzono pomiary penetracji, gęstości, płynięcia (MVR), siły odrywania, odporności na ścinanie oraz migracji plastyfikatora. Uzyskane dane sugerują możliwość wtórnego wykorzystania tego typu odpadu w zgodzie z zasadami gospodarki cyrkulacyjnej jako dodatek do mieszanek uszczelniających.

Chewing gum is a product of growing economic importance and diverse appli-cations; however, its waste is difficult to biodegrade, posing a significant environmental problem. The aim of the chapter was to evaluate the parameters of butyl rubber compounds used in sealing materials modified with chewing gum waste. Two types of production waste were assessed: one containing only the gum base, and the other containing the gum base with food additives. Measurements of penetration, density, melt volume rate (MVR), peel strength, shear resistance, and plasticizer migration were conducted. The data obtained sug-gest the potential for secondary use of this type of waste in accordance with the principles of circular economy, resulting in useful and high-quality compounds.

title: Relations with Employees and the Market Environment as Pillars of Corporate Social Responsibility in Small and Medium-Sized Enterprises

abstracts.content: Modern enterprises operate in a dynamically changing socio-economic environment, which places increasing demands on them not only in terms of economic efficiency, but also social responsibility. Globalization, demographic changes, growing social expectations, as well as the transformation of the labor market make responsible business activity an important element of the development strategy of companies - regardless of their size or industry. In addition to pursuing economic goals, enterprises should take into account social interests, care for the environment and shape transparent relations with a wide range of stakeholders. The authors’ research focused on two key pillars of corporate social responsibility - relations with employees and the functioning of the company on the market. Actions undertaken in these pillars translate not only into the image of the organization, but also into its stability and ability for long-term development. The aim of the conducted research was to obtain knowledge on the perception of the concept of corporate social responsibility by entrepreneurs in the SME sector, with particular emphasis on its key pillars, applied principles and examples of practical activities. In addition, the study aimed to analyze the relationships between individual activities carried out in the areas of two pillars: employee relations and the market. The research was conducted in 2024 among 182 enterprises from the SME sector, and the sample selection was purposeful. The analysis of the research results showed that in the pillar of employee relations, good relations with employees were considered the most important. Next, taking care of the well-being of employees and their safety at work and taking care of the image, reputation, development of the company and its employees were indicated. The least important area for respondents turned out to be social benefits. In the market pillar, good relations and honesty with customers, employees and contractors were considered the most important, as well as taking care of the quality of products and services, meeting customer needs. One third of the respondents indicated compliance with legal regulations and standards. The research results also show that in the pillar of employee relations, statistically significant relationships between the areas studied are inversely proportional. The area of ​​taking care of the well-being of employees and their safety at work shows a relationship with the area of ​​taking care of the image, reputation, development of the company and its employees. In addition, the researched area of ​​taking care of the image, reputation, development of the company and its employees shows a statistically significant correlation with the area covering good relations with employees. The area covering good relations with employees shows a correlation with the area concerning honesty in the implementation of concluded contracts, timely payment of salaries. The area of ​​social benefits did not show statistically significant correlations with the other areas studied in this pillar. The area of ​​taking care of the well-being of employees and their safety at work was positively correlated with the area from the pillar related to compliance with standards, environmental protection regulations. Within the market pillar, the research results indicate that the area of ​​good relations and honesty towards customers, employees and contractors does not show a statistically significant correlation with the other areas studied in this pillar. The area of ​​taking care of the quality of products and services, meeting customer needs shows a correlation with the area of ​​cooperation, partnership and fair-play competition. In addition, this area shows a correlation with the area of ​​compliance with legal regulations and standards in an inversely proportional manner, and directly proportional to the area of ​​reliability and ethics in conduct. The area of ​​taking care of the image, reputation, development of the company and its employees was characterized by a positive correlation with the area of ​​cooperation, partnership and fair-play competition.

title: Possibilities of Using 3D Printing with Polymers as Structural Components

abstracts.content: This article investigates the potential of using polymer-based Fused Filament Fabrication (FFF) 3D printing to manufacture structural components. This study aimed to explore the application of this technology within manufacturing processes. This research focused on material analysis, using a gear wheel from a lawn mower’s drive system as a case study. To achieve the purpose of this study, a reverse engineering process was carried out to create 2D and 3D documentation based on a physical piece. The geometric model created in the CAD environment was optimized for volume. It was intended to keep the material expenditure unchanged, which is intensified during the 3D printing process due to the need to apply an adhesive layer and supports. The final design process of the geometric model of the prototype was subjected to numerical analyses in terms of total deformation and reduced stresses for materials commonly used as filaments in the FDM/FFF 3D printing technology. The basic filaments PLA, ABS, and PA6 and PA12 were analyzed in this study. The results of the analyses showed that two of the four selected filaments had to be rejected due to significant deterioration in strength properties. Finally, the prototype workpieces were printed using materials approved for the manufacturing process.

title: From NFRD to CSRD – Non-Financial Reporting „Yesterday and Today”

abstracts.content:
Purpose: The purpose of the article is to systematise and present the determinants of -financial reporting (until 2024) and sustainable development (from 2025) in Poland.
Design/methodology/approach: The literature and legal acts study method was used in the article, as well as the analysis and synthesis method, the descriptive method and deductive reasoning.
Findings: Companies have long been required to raise their social responsibility towards the environment and society, and these requirements have been "backed up" by the European Commission by gradually tightening up and formalising sustainability reporting obligations (previously -financial reporting). An important development in that process was the adoption of the 2022/2555 Directive of the European Parliament and of the Council of 14 December 2022 (CSDR). In 2024, the indicated Directive was implemented into Polish law by the Act of 6 December 2024 on amendments to the Accounting Act, the Act on Statutory Auditors, Audit Firms and Public Supervision and certain other acts. As a result of the introduction of the Directive, the disclosure of ESG information – still voluntary for some entities (although probably only for some time) and with a marketing impact – has become and will become increasingly regulated, necessary and mandatory. At the same time, in addition to the double materiality and approval necessity of reports, a novelty in relation to the previous legal framework will be (probably starting from the reports for 2025 – the deadlines have already been postponed several times) the introduction and unification of reporting standards.
Originality/value: The value of the article is the analysis, synthesis and systematisation of issues related to the -financial/sustainability reporting framework in Poland, especially in the context of the recent, significant modification of legal provisions related to the implementation of the CSRD into national legislation.

title: AI-Generated Hate Speech in Industrial Enterprises: a Systematic Review of Challenges and Mitigation Strategies in the Industry 5.0 Era

abstracts.content: This article presents a systematic review of the literature on AI-generated hate speech in industrial enterprises, considering the transition from Industry 4.0 to Industry 5.0. The study aims to identify key challenges related to the ethical, legal, and technological aspects of AI implementation in the industrial sector and proposes mitigation strategies to address the risks associated with AI-generated harmful content. The research highlights that AI systems, particularly those based on language models, can unintentionally propagate discriminatory or offensive content, posing risks to corporate reputation, organizational culture, and regulatory compliance. The study underscores the increasing role of regulations, such as the EU’s AI Act, which classifies AI-generated content systems as high-risk applications requiring stringent oversight. The article outlines various strategies to mitigate the effects of AI-generated hate speech, including bias detection in AI models, real-time content moderation mechanisms, and human oversight in AI interactions. Transparency, interdisciplinary collaboration, and adherence to ethical guidelines are emphasized as essential components of responsible AI deployment in industrial settings. In conclusion, the study highlights the necessity for further exploration of AI’s impact on digital communication within enterprises and the development of global regulatory standards to effectively manage AI-generated content in the Industry 5.0 era.

title: Implementation and Performance of Post-Quantum Cryptography for Resource Constrained Consumer Electronics

abstracts.content: The proliferation of consumer electronics (CE), from smartphones to IoT-enabled smart devices, has significantly transformed our everyday lives, enhancing convenience and connectivity. However, these transformations to modern life have introduced security vulnerabilities, particularly as traditional cryptographic algorithms face mounting challenges from quantum computing technology. Post-quantum cryptography (PQC) has emerged as a promising solution for providing future-proof security for next-generation CE against the quantum computing threat. PQC algorithms are developed to resist cyberattacks from both classical and quantum computers, ensuring long-term security solutions. This article explores the integration of PQC into next-generation CE devices to ensure confidentiality, integrity, and user privacy. It highlights the vulnerabilities of classical cryptographic methods and underscores the need for transitioning to quantum-resistant solutions. Moreover, the practical implementation of PQC in resource-constrained CE devices is analyzed. Our evaluation shows that optimized PQC incurs negligible overhead on servers (5%), can be up to 12× slower on CE devices, and reduces communication overhead below conventional ECC (1 KB vs. 2.1 KB), while achieving hardware throughput thousands of times higher than RSA. By proactively exploring the opportunities and challenges associated with PQC, this research outlines future directions for implementing robust, scalable, and secure systems, thereby ensuring consumer trust in the evolving technological landscape.
